manifest.name: demo-bundle
manifest.description: Two demo policies. Members: demo-write-gate: blocks on an agent's file writes and at turn end; demo-shell-guard: refuses a matched shell command before it runs; demo-advice: advisory only. It is skill text, and nothing stops a violation. [Advisory skill only; enforcement needs chock installed in the repo.]

hooks.command: git -c 'alias.chock-sh=!set -f; IFS=; test -f $1 || { echo chock: the plugin launcher is missing, so this call cannot be checked. Refusing. >&2; exit 2; }; sh' chock-sh "__CHOCK_PLUGIN_ROOT__/scripts/launch.sh" "__CHOCK_PLUGIN_ROOT__/scripts/chock_bundle.py" --bundle demo-bundle --member demo-write-gate "__CHOCK_PLUGIN_ROOT__/scripts/openhands.py" --gate "__CHOCK_PLUGIN_ROOT__/scripts/demo-write-gate/gate.json"
